_comment: A hull-only xdyn vessel with no Allocation task at all -- same pattern
as fremm_drift_only.json. wamv.yaml has no 'controlled forces'/
'commands' section at all (confirmed by grepping the file), so an
empty command set is harmless and the vessel drifts correctly under
hydrodynamics + its own embedded 'ekman current' model. Only
Navigation runs, for telemetry -- there is nothing to command.
This is a separate capability from wamv_kinematic.json: that one is
controllable (Kinematic backend, generic pipeline); this one is real
xdyn dynamics with no propulsion at all, since wamv.yaml has no
thruster model. Same vehicle, two different, both-legitimate demos.
Uses energy.world, not bluerov_ekman.world: the current model comes
entirely from wamv.yaml's own embedded 'ekman current' block,
independent of which .world file is loaded.
wamv.yaml now also has real gravity/hydrostatic + a wave spectrum (same
airy/jonswap pattern as commando/fremm), not just current drag, so the
hull actually rides the waves. spawn z is 0.096, not 0.0 or -0.3: that's
the equilibrium draft for the 100kg body in wamv_simplified.stl's
twin-pontoon hull (found by bisecting submerged volume against the
mesh's own z-profile) -- spawning far from equilibrium gives a large,
unnecessary transient before it settles into its wave response.
